corrections.description: Since January 2026 Google has been rolling out AI thread summaries, Help Me Write and Suggested Replies to Gmail users at no cost, starting in the U.S. in English; asking questions across the whole inbox is for paid Google AI plans. So 'summarise this thread' and 'draft a reply' on a parent's own Gmail are already on the phone. This is a reason to keep the personal-inbox features behind the school mailbox, not to pull them forward.
